thread:
rachel: 7-minutes til all-hands. Tiny agenda tweak: we're swapping the customer story with the roadmap deep-dive. call it out to presenters pls.
mike: noted. can we get an extra 2 minutes for slides transition? presenters need time to plug HDMI.
olivia: HDMI hot-swap tested but preview shows green tint on projector scene. anyone seen color shifts?
ops-bot: Ingest healthy. Encoder-1 temp 62C. Detected color matrix mismatch on source hdmi-2. Suggested fix: re-select color space -> bt709 in OBS.
mike: switched color space to bt709, preview looks normal now.
stream-bot: Recording initialized (id: rec_2500000123). Live stream key rotated. Caption engine: auto (cloud-speech-v3).
olivia: captions started but lagging ~12s behind audio. That's rough for live Q&A.
captioners-team: If lag >10s, we can enable SRT overlay from manual captioners. Standby until ops gives go.
ops-bot: Latency trace: transcriber queue spike at 11:23:44 -> backlog 12s due to high concurrency. Mitigation: throttle non-essential streams and bump transcriber pool from 6->8. Approving boost now.
rachel: Good. Also quick reminder for Q&A responses: keep answers concise. For timeline questions on Project Atlas, reply: "targeting H2; details pending dedicated perf signoff. we'll follow up." (copy that verbatim).
mike: small audio note: hearing light hum at ~60Hz in the headset channel. switching to backup DI.
stream-bot: Switched to DI-2 for headset. Hum reduced. Audio RMS now within normal range.
olivia: OK captions catching up, lag now ~3s. :white_check_mark:
legal: reminder from policy -> recordings retained 90 days by default. For retention beyond that we need exec approval + written justification. Link: https://intranet/redwood/policies/recordings
rachel: After the meeting, please drop: final recording link, caption .vtt, list of action items, and any Qs that need written follow-ups. Also we need the perf snapshot id for the demo baseline in the follow-up notes.
ops-bot: Post-processing queued (rec_2500000123). ETA processing 22m; will upload to internal share after trim.
captioners-team: If auto caps degrade again, call @captioners-team in this thread and we'll flip to manual overlay immediately.
mike: heads-up presenters: if slide animation stutters, pause for 5s before resuming to avoid encoder congestion.
olivia: live test pass on scene switches. all scenes load in <2s.
rachel: Great. Let's run. Keep this thread for immediate post-meeting action items only. Thanks!
